title: does errata 2477 in Engine Control eTPU Library (AN4907SW) is applicable for SPC563M64L5?
content:
Am using Engine Control eTPU Library (AN4907SW) in the SPC563M64L5 device.

And in the source files, there is a piece of code which needs to be enabled for MPC5500 devices as it is mentioned in the comment that “an errata 2477 is present on MPC5500 devices”. Since SPC563M64L5 device is almost similar to MPC5634M device which is MPC5500 family as both jointly developed. does these errata applicable to SPC563M64L5 as well?
